FlowDefinition.description: Stamps the Churn Date on a Dental Product and Lab record when it is updated to Status "Lab Churn" while Churn Date is still blank, so CS leadership can report on lab churn events by time period without cross-object reports. Runs before save (fast field update) to avoid a second DML. Entry criteria require a blank Churn Date (update only, not create), so the original churn date is preserved if the record re-enters Lab Churn later. (INC3-13)
FlowDefinition.masterLabel: Dental Product and Lab - Before - Stamp Lab Churn Date
